heroTagline: i build stuff — minecraft mods, tools, bots, and whatever else seems fun
aboutP1: Hey, I'm Matthew — a {{age}}-year-old developer from Tallinn, Estonia. I started out with Minecraft modding, and that slowly turned into an obsession with building things.
aboutP2: Now I work with React, Python, Rust, and Java, creating everything from Minecraft plugins and Discord bots to full-stack apps and AI projects. I use Arch Linux daily, live inside my terminal, and spend most of my time either coding, optimizing, or breaking something just to figure out how it works.
timelineStart: Started learning to code — Java basics, experimenting with everything
timelineMods: Got into Minecraft modding — built my first plugins, discovered what I actually enjoy
timelineBots: Built Discord bots, started learning Python and web scraping
timelineWeb: Switched to web dev — React, TypeScript, full-stack projects
timelineNow: Arch Linux daily driver, Rust, AI projects, building my own ecosystem
